independent_blockers.reason: PortableProof contains only role labels and raw RPC transcripts, not authenticated independent capture/operator provenance. A valid one-server transcript copied into primary and witness roles cannot be distinguished offline using these inputs.
independent_blockers.required_external_input: Independently enrolled signed capture/witness evidence bound to exact proof/head/time plus externally reviewed operator independence; no trust keys from stdin.
independent_blockers.blocked_test: Same-server witness masquerade must reject independently; cryptographic consensus authentication alone does not establish operator independence.

independent_blockers.reason: Native ICS23 proves assets; Reserve fields and nonempty hashes do not prove all liabilities, maximum uncertain outflows, inventory completeness or nonoverlap. The reusable signed review primitive itself cannot establish completeness or reviewer independence.
independent_blockers.required_external_input: Current complete immutable account-local inventory, cross-writer census, conservative unknown-claim reservations and independently provisioned accounting/custody reviews.
independent_blockers.blocked_test: An otherwise genuine bank proof with omitted historical/external liabilities must not manufacture a grounded reserve success.

independent_blockers.reason: Repeated stateless verification cannot establish global prior receipt nonconsumption across markets, days, manual/external writers or signing journals. Existing journal fences and HD atomic unique receipt consumption remain distinct authorities.
independent_blockers.required_external_input: Protected current journal/receipt authority and existing downstream atomic consumption, with independently reviewed cross-estate writer exclusion. No duplicate controller.
independent_blockers.blocked_test: Cross-invocation/global receipt replay cannot be declared rejected from proof bytes alone.

independent_blockers.reason: Self-reported source, an executable calculating its own digest and a caller-provided anchor cannot certify independent accepted build/install provenance.
independent_blockers.required_external_input: Independent accepted source-to-binary build receipt, root-controlled installation manifest and separately provisioned Comet anchor/capture/reviewer roots.
independent_blockers.blocked_test: Tampered source/binary/root must fail against external accepted pins rather than self-consistent caller values.

invocation_contract.implementable_design: A single fixed absolute root-controlled nonsecret verifier configuration, independent of stdin and sanitized environment, can support the exact argv. Fail closed if missing/unqualified. Preserve existing --check/config semantics. This design is not implemented by this assessment.
invocation_contract.protected_reader_conflict: ReadPrivateFile requires file owner equal process EUID and mode with no group/world permissions. An ordinary nonroot HD child cannot reuse it for root-owned 0600 config. Do not run HD as root to bypass this.
required_reader_properties: Fixed path; no stdin/environment path override.
Root-owned nonsecret data and root-protected ancestors; no symlinks or group/world writes.
Same checked descriptor for bounded strict read; no executable configuration.
Do not provision or install configuration under this source-only action.

bounds.required_output: Exactly one bounded compact JSON success or fixed nonsecret refusal plus nonzero exit; no raw proofs or keys in logs.
bounds.strict_decode: UTF8, unknown/duplicate/folded-key and trailing-data refusal; explicit deadline, bounded allocations; no live RPC fallback.

already_defined.bytes: Exact raw stdin UTF8 bytes, unchanged whitespace.
Exact installed executable file bytes; also require external expected digest.

digest_contract.disposition: Do not invent byte parity or echo caller hashes. Agree a precise source-reviewed Go/HD contract and independently verify required external artifacts before any success verdict.

hd_owner_repairs.exact_repair: Append $12 for chain_time to VALUES. Result must have 14 columns, 14 VALUES and 12 supplied parameters.
hd_owner_repairs.extra_requirement: Validate chain_time as authenticated selected receipt BlockTime.

hd_owner_repairs.exact_repair: Append $25 for issuer_provenance to VALUES. Result must have 28 columns, 28 VALUES and 25 supplied parameters.
Update only after a real new native verifier source and independent source/binary/anchor/install contract are accepted. Do not substitute a docs-only SHA as proof of an implemented verifier.
required_pin_contract: Independently accepted source-to-binary build mapping and exact executable SHA256.
Agreed protected trust-anchor byte hash and independent source/reviewer roots.
Root-protected fixed configuration/install manifest; ordinary nonroot execution.
Canonical economic-key and digest contracts shared with HD.

hd_owner_repairs.exact_requirement: Keep EPOCH_V3_NATIVE_PG_FINANCIAL_ENABLED=false; preserve restricted NOLOGIN proof-writer group with separately enrolled LOGIN NOINHERIT, SERIALIZABLE atomic persistence and result PERSISTED_UNCREDITED. Do not credit positions or enable a production consumer.
Retain documented actual HD same-market repeated-original-receipt rejection. The cross-market 40+60 golden is authentic source parity; do not widen this P0 or silently normalize this mismatch.

required_independent_pg16_tests.test: Execute repaired actual ingress INSERT statements in a disposable PG16 database using separately enrolled LOGIN NOINHERIT with SET LOCAL ROLE epoch_v3_proof_writer; persist one receipt, its native certificate and both account evidence rows.
Successful persistence returns PERSISTED_UNCREDITED and leaves positions, entitlements and receipt consumption unchanged.
Fail separately after receipt INSERT, certificate INSERT, each bank INSERT and epoch/account validation; assert no partial financial rows survive.
Ordinary app and consumer logins cannot INSERT native proof rows or SET ROLE proof writer; proof writer cannot update positions, credit, settle or gain UPDATE on immutable bank records.
Equal immutable same-root evidence can be reused; changed amount, inventory, nonoverlap, proof or root refuses atomically without UPDATE privileges.
Concurrent physical-receipt duplicates, changed operations and serialization conflicts fail closed; no automatic retry turns an unknown outcome into a second consumption.
Malformed/oversized/duplicate-key/trailing JSON, missing config/root, source/binary/anchor/raw digest mismatch, timeout, nonzero exit or partial stdout causes zero PG writes.
